_note: Job A batch 3. Past-due claims from 2024-12-31 to 2025-10-31. Corpus searched directly on two priority questions: whether a tariff-war statement predates the inauguration (it does) and whether the September word was given in March (it is not in the corpus before June 2025).

evidence.summary: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act passed the Senate on 1 July 2025, the House on 3 July, and was signed on 4 July 2025. CBO scored it as adding roughly 3.4 trillion dollars to deficits over 2025-2034, with several provisions expiring in 2028. US equities returned about 17.9 percent in 2025 and the dollar index fell roughly 10 percent over the year, its worst first half since 1973.
evidence.rationale: The shape is right: a very large bill, an economy that then looked strong, and provisions that lapse in 2028. Three things hold it at partial. The five trillion figure is wrong by about a third against the CBO score. The 3 July telling lands on the day the House passed it, so that telling is commentary, not forecast; only the August 2023 telling about pumping the economy full of money is genuinely prior, and 2024 policy was tightening, not loosening. And the sealed fate of the dollar is a claim about a future that has not arrived: the dollar fell in 2025 but remains the reserve currency.

evidence.summary: No Israel-Syria peace agreement was signed in 2024 or since. Assad fell in December 2024. US-mediated Israel-Syria security talks continued through 2025 and 2026, producing a joint intelligence-sharing mechanism in January 2026, and President Ahmed al-Sharaa said in July 2026 that a security agreement was still being worked toward and that he balked at normalisation.
evidence.rationale: The stated criterion was an agreement signed after the reported delay, and twenty-six months on there is still no signature. He is also reporting other people's news coverage of a delay rather than seeing anything, which the telling makes explicit. Negotiations existing is not the claim.

evidence.summary: No two-state agreement was reached between September 2023 and the end of 2024. The nearest development came nine months later, when the UK, Canada, Australia and Portugal recognised Palestinian statehood on 21 September 2025 and France, Belgium, Luxembourg, Malta and Monaco followed on 22 September; recognition by individual states is not an agreement between the parties.
evidence.rationale: He offers it explicitly as his own opinion rather than a word, which is the honest framing and is recorded as such. The window he set closed with no agreement. The 2025 recognitions are scored under two-state-third-temple and are not counted twice here; they are also not the thing this claim named, which was an agreement reached.

evidence.summary: In 2024 the WHO declared mpox a public health emergency of international concern on 14 August over clade Ib, and H5N1 spread widely in US dairy cattle and poultry. Neither became a pandemic: clade I transmission outside Africa never approached 2022 clade II levels, and H5N1 showed no sustained human-to-human transmission. The mpox emergency was lifted in September 2025.
evidence.rationale: Something did try to be an event and turned into nothing, twice, which is what he described in December 2023. The base rate is the whole difficulty and has to be stated: almost every outbreak scare fizzles. Between 2009 and 2024 the WHO declared eight public health emergencies and one became a pandemic. Predicting that the next scare deflates is predicting the modal outcome. Partial, and no higher.

evidence.summary: Same 2024 record as for virus-plot-defused: an mpox PHEIC declared 14 August 2024 and an H5N1 cattle outbreak, neither becoming a pandemic. No disease scare peaked and deflated specifically in April 2024; the H5N1 dairy herd detections began in late March 2024 and continued through the year rather than deflating.
evidence.rationale: This is the same 28 December 2023 telling as virus-plot-defused, split into two canonical claims by the extractor because one version carries an April date and the balloon image and the other does not. Both are scored the same way and neither is credited twice. The April detail, which is the only thing distinguishing this claim, has no match: nothing rose and deflated in that month. A same_event_as edge between the two would be the right cleanup rather than a merge, because the April timing is a real difference in substance.

evidence.summary: No transfer of wealth to churches is visible in the 2024 giving data: religious giving rose in current dollars roughly in line with inflation and continued its long decline as a share of total US giving.
evidence.rationale: A supernatural harvest of the wealth of the sinner has no denominator, no counterparty and no threshold, so any individual testimony confirms it and no aggregate can refute it. The 2026 telling attaches it to a named bill passing, which would be checkable, but that telling is not yet due and belongs to a different window.

evidence.summary: The four-year window he describes runs from late 2024 to the close of the shmita cycle in 2028 and has not expired. Twenty months in, the reprieve did not end at the start of 2025 as one telling allowed: US equities returned about 17.9 percent in 2025, no recession was dated, and no national collapse occurred through August 2026.
evidence.rationale: Recording evidence now rather than a verdict, because the claim's own window runs to 2028 and closing it early would be as wrong as leaving it unchecked. What can be said already: the short branch he floated on 4 November 2024, that the window might run only to the first of the year, is falsified. Two structural notes for whoever scores it in 2028. He attributes the reprieve to accumulated prayer, which makes the good outcome evidence for the word and the bad outcome evidence that people stopped praying. And the 10 November telling makes success depend on what the hearers do with the time, which the extractor flagged unfalsifiable on the spot.

evidence.summary: The presidential transition completed on schedule; Trump was inaugurated on 20 January 2025 and Biden left office. No attempt to disrupt the transfer of power occurred in the 59 days concerned, and no attempt on Trump or his family occurred in that period.
evidence.rationale: A prayer that nothing happen, followed by nothing happening, against a base rate in which every American transfer of power but one has been uneventful. The design treats prayer conditionality as a field, not as an excuse, and that cuts here: the non-event cannot be counted as a match. Recorded so it leaves the unchecked queue.

evidence.summary: Trump was inaugurated on 20 January 2025 and signed an executive order on 23 January directing release of the JFK, RFK and MLK assassination records; roughly 80,000 pages were published on 18 March 2025. The Justice Department released an initial tranche of Epstein files on 27 February 2025. Markets did not shift upward: the S&P 500 peaked on 19 February 2025 and fell about 19 percent by 8 April.
evidence.rationale: The dam-of-withheld-material half has a real referent. Large bodies of long-withheld federal records were ordered released within three days of the inauguration and published within two months, which is close to what he described in December. The rest failed. There was no visible national turnaround dated to 20 January, and the new economy he attached to it ran the other way for the following eleven weeks. Note also that Trump had campaigned publicly on releasing the JFK and Epstein files, so the release was an announced intention rather than a hidden one.

evidence.summary: No woman standing alongside Kamala Harris was attacked between July 2024 and January 2025. Harris left office on 20 January 2025; no member of her staff or entourage was assaulted in the period.
evidence.rationale: The one identifying detail he was given, the face, is explicitly blotted out in the vision, which leaves only sandy blonde hair and proximity to Harris. Even read at its loosest, with hit taken to include a political rather than a physical blow, nothing in the window fits, and Harris's own circle simply dispersed at the end of the term. Scored as expired rather than unfalsifiable because the window and the setting were both specified.

evidence.summary: Super Bowl LIX was played on 9 February 2025. The S&P 500 set its record close ten days later on 19 February 2025 and then fell about 19 percent to 8 April on the reciprocal tariff announcement. No measurable financial acceleration occurred in the weeks around the named date; the period marked the top before the year's largest drawdown.
evidence.rationale: A named date, an economic direction, and the opposite happened within ten days. He anchors it to three weeks after the swearing-in, which makes the window tight enough to fail, and it failed. The only reading that saves it is that the February record high counts as the acceleration, which would require ignoring that it was the peak.

evidence.summary: A total lunar eclipse occurred on 13-14 March 2025. The United States began a sustained air campaign against the Houthis in Yemen on 15 March 2025, the largest month of US airstrikes there since 2015. Israel resumed strikes on Gaza on 18 March 2025, killing more than 400 people in one night and ending the eight-week ceasefire; Netanyahu called it only the beginning.
evidence.rationale: Two war escalations landed one and four days after the date he named, and he named the date on 5 March, before either. That is the case for him. Against him: the eclipse was an astronomical certainty known for decades and supplies no information; the Gaza ceasefire was already visibly collapsing over the phase-two deadline when he spoke; and wars that are already running escalate often enough that a fortnight window around any date has a high hit rate. He also credits the framing to Kim Clement rather than to a word of his own.

evidence.summary: Reciprocal tariffs were announced on 2 April 2025 and the S&P 500 fell about 19 percent from its February record by 8 April. Within this corpus the claim of a prior warning checks out: a 28 December 2024 passage speaks of great trade wars between China and America, and a 27 November 2024 passage prays over the tariffs, both before the inauguration.
evidence.rationale: The retro claim is honest, which is worth saying because several others in this database are not: he did say it beforehand and the passages are in the corpus. What the base rate takes back is most of the credit. Trump ran on tariffs for two years, named specific rates during the campaign, and by late November 2024 had publicly promised 25 percent tariffs on Canada and Mexico. Forecasting a trade war in December 2024 was restating a stated policy. The 2 April telling then adds nothing, since it quotes Trump's own post announcing the date, and the 12 May prayer for a breakthrough on the 13th coincided with the US-China Geneva truce announced on 12 May, one day early and already trailed in the weekend's coverage.

evidence.summary: 2025 brought a 19 percent equity drawdown in April, a twelve-day Israel-Iran war in June with US strikes on Iranian nuclear sites, the assassination of Charlie Kirk in September, and the longest federal government shutdown on record. It also brought a 17.9 percent total return for the S&P 500, three Federal Reserve rate cuts, no recession, and no US hurricane landfall for the first time in a decade.
evidence.rationale: Half the year fits the description and half of it flatly does not, which is the problem with the claim rather than with the year. He hedges it twice in the same breath, saying 2025 has the potential to be dark and that things can change in the spirit, so both outcomes were pre-covered. He also leans on three other named voices rather than his own hearing, and says explicitly he has not heard when. Partial for the genuine crises, held there by the hedge.

evidence.summary: The Liberal Party under Mark Carney won the 28 April 2025 Canadian federal election with 43.8 percent of the vote and 169 seats, forming a minority government. Conservative leader Pierre Poilievre lost his own seat. The Conservatives had led national polling by double digits before Trudeau's resignation in January 2025.
evidence.rationale: He prayed for the righteous vote to prevail and for a result too big to rig, and the party he was praying against won while the opposition leader lost his own seat. What belongs in the record beside that is his own conduct two days later: he says on 30 April that he saw in a vision Canada would go the way it did and prayed anyway because that is the job. That is a rare thing in this corpus, a plainly acknowledged loss, and it is the reason this entry is worth reading rather than just counting.

evidence.summary: No measurable event corresponds to doors opening for an unnamed audience in April 2025. US nonfarm payrolls grew 158,000 in April 2025, an ordinary month. Nothing involving Oklahoma or a land rush occurred in April 2025.
evidence.rationale: The extractor flagged the central telling unfalsifiable at corpus level before any outcome was known, and that is right: doors opening for people is satisfied by any listener's good month. The two elements that could have been checked, the Sooners and land detail and something of note around Easter, produced nothing, but they are too thin to carry a verdict on their own.

evidence.summary: No attack occurred in Las Vegas in February, March or April 2025. The nearest event is the Cybertruck explosion outside the Trump International Hotel in Las Vegas on 1 January 2025, which killed the perpetrator and injured seven, three weeks before he described the vision.
evidence.rationale: The window he named closed empty. What matters more is the sequence: he described this on 21 January 2025, three weeks after an actual Las Vegas explosion had been in the news, and then placed the attack he saw in the future warm months. He also removes his own timing marker in the same sentence, noting that Las Vegas is warm year round, which leaves leaves on trees as the only seasonal cue in a desert city.

evidence.summary: The United States struck Iranian nuclear sites at Fordow, Natanz and Isfahan on 21-22 June 2025. Iran's parliament voted on 22 June to approve closing the Strait of Hormuz, with the decision reserved to the Supreme National Security Council. The strait was never closed; shipping continued amid GPS interference and higher insurance rates, and a ceasefire took effect on 24 June 2025.
evidence.rationale: The week he named did bring the most serious threat to Hormuz in years, and he named a waterway rather than being handed one. But the ordering is fatal to a strong score: he spoke on 23 June, after the US strikes and after Iran's parliament vote were both global news. There is no forward content left except the days Monday to Thursday, and the actual movement was toward de-escalation, with the ceasefire landing on the Tuesday of his own window.

evidence.summary: No attack occurred on a Trump property, on the president, or on Kai Trump between 14 June and 6 July 2025. No incident involving Trump family members is recorded in that window.
evidence.rationale: Another prayer that nothing happen, with nothing happening. The one detail that could have made it scoreable, seeing the granddaughter's face specifically, points at a person no harm came to, and there is no way to distinguish a protective word from a quiet three weeks. Recorded as unfalsifiable, consistent with how the other protection prayers in this batch are treated.

evidence.summary: A military parade marking the Army's 250th anniversary was held in Washington on 14 June 2025, coinciding with Trump's birthday and Flag Day; it had been publicly announced in early May 2025. Nationwide No Kings protests were held the same day. No founding or rebirth event involving Israel occurred in June or July 2025; Israel and Iran fought a twelve-day war beginning 13 June 2025.
evidence.rationale: The parade he saw on a June calendar did happen, and patriotic programming did run into July around the approach to the 250th anniversary year. The parade was announced publicly about three weeks before he described it, so seeing June and a military parade was reading the calendar. The distinctive parts, a baby wrapped in a blanket seen with Israel and a rebirthing in America, have no referent; what Israel actually did that week was go to war.

evidence.summary: No widely recognised outpouring or staged escalation of miracles occurred between Rosh Hashanah 2024 and Rosh Hashanah 2025. Pew's Religious Landscape Study, released February 2025, found the decline in US Christian affiliation had slowed and may have levelled off, with no measured increase.
evidence.rationale: Blade, ear and full manifestation is a growth metaphor with no threshold at any stage, and the glory rising ankle to waist deep supplies its own excuse for a year in which nothing visible happens: it was only the ear. Nothing could have refuted it. The seismic detail attached to the December telling is scored under rosh-2024-acceleration, where the numbers actually go against him.

evidence.summary: September 2025 brought the assassination of Charlie Kirk on 10 September at Utah Valley University, recognition of Palestinian statehood by the UK, Canada, Australia, Portugal, France, Belgium, Luxembourg, Malta and Monaco on 21-22 September, and Trump's UN General Assembly address on 23 September. Within this corpus the September word with a circled month and dust appears from 13 June 2025 and again on 10 August 2025.
evidence.rationale: Twelve tellings, a named month three months ahead, and a month that was genuinely consequential. That is real and it is why this is the most-told past-due claim in the database. What it does not have is content. Acceleration, labour pains and running out of time name no event, and the one concrete marker, dust, has no referent in what happened: the Kirk shooting produced no dust, smoke, explosion or collapse. A month circled in advance with no stated content cannot fail, and September is a month he circles repeatedly across years.

evidence.summary: The UK, Canada, Australia and Portugal recognised Palestinian statehood on 21 September 2025; France, Belgium, Luxembourg, Malta and Monaco followed on 22 September at a two-state summit co-hosted by France and Saudi Arabia. Trump addressed the General Assembly on 23 September, opposing recognition. Roughly three quarters of UN member states now recognise Palestine.
evidence.rationale: A visible split between nations over recognition did occur in the week he named, and the division-of-nations framing fits the event closely. The dates were public before he spoke: Trump's 23 September UN slot was scheduled, France had announced in July that it would recognise at this session, and Canada and the UK had said the same. His 30 August telling notes the schedule itself. So the week was known and the alignment was foreseeable; the contribution is the framing, not the forecast.

evidence.summary: No transition, tribulation onset or comparable event began after Rosh Hashanah 2025, which fell on 22-24 September. World affairs continued without a discontinuity in the period.
evidence.rationale: He gave a specific instruction, to look from Rosh Hashanah in September, and named a specific thing to look for. Nothing came. The concept of Adam's lease coming up is itself untestable, but the dated instruction attached to it was not, and it failed. Scored as expired rather than unfalsifiable because he supplied the date himself and repeated it three times.

evidence.summary: No single 24-hour period between September 2024 and September 2025 changed American life comprehensively. The most disruptive single days in the window were 2 April 2025, when reciprocal tariffs were announced, and 10 September 2025, when Charlie Kirk was killed; neither altered everything anyone had known.
evidence.rationale: The claim is unusual for this corpus in setting a genuinely high bar, everything anyone has ever known changing inside a day, and the bar was not met. The April 2025 retelling then does something the database is built to catch: he says everything changed in a 24-hour period, past tense, without naming the day. Recorded as expired for the original window, and the retelling is a fulfilment assertion rather than evidence.

evidence.summary: Charlie Kirk was shot and killed on 10 September 2025 at Utah Valley University, five days after the 5th, the date he named as the start of the fog. Within this corpus a search for September combined with a circled month or dust returns nothing before June 2025; the earliest such passage is 13 June 2025, with another on 10 August 2025. There is no March 2025 passage giving the word.
evidence.rationale: The month carried a genuinely irreversible political event and the red circle and bloodline detail is closer to what happened than most imagery in this corpus. The corpus check goes against him on the priority question the extractor raised: he says on 9 September that the word was given back around March and that they have been praying over it since, and there is no such passage before June. That is the same pattern as the Yankees claim, a later date of origin than the one he gives. Partial: the September framing is real and prior, the March origin is not.

evidence.summary: No rapture occurred in September 2025. A body of online prophecy had pointed to 23-24 September 2025 as a rapture date; he said on 30 August 2025 that he personally did not believe it would come then.
evidence.rationale: The second pre-commitment against his own field in this database, after the April 2024 eclipse, and again he was right. It is scored the same way for the same reason: a forecast that nothing happens is indistinguishable from the base rate, and no rapture is the outcome every previous date has produced. The value in the record is the willingness to say it in advance while others were selling the date, not the accuracy.

evidence.summary: September 2025 is widely remembered for the assassination of Charlie Kirk on 10 September. The claim that he told people to watch from the 23rd of September on is made retrospectively on 3 November 2025; the killing he offers as its fulfilment occurred on the 10th, thirteen days before the date he says he named.
evidence.rationale: The retro claim defeats itself. He says the day was given, watch from the 23rd on, and then points to an event that happened before it as the fulfilment. Either the date was wrong or the event is not the fulfilment. A month-to-remember framing does exist in the corpus before September, so the month is not fabricated, but the specific dated form asserted in November is contradicted by the date of the thing it claims to have predicted.

evidence.summary: Charlie Kirk was shot on 10 September 2025 and the phrase shot heard round the world was used widely in coverage and commentary from that day. The telling in this corpus is dated 11 September 2025, the day after.
evidence.rationale: There is no forward claim here. He describes headlines he saw, and the headlines existed the day before he spoke. Whether the seeing was in a vision or on a screen cannot be settled from the record, and that is exactly why it cannot be scored either way. Recorded as unfalsifiable, with the one-day gap stated so a reader can weigh it.

evidence.summary: USGS recorded 10 magnitude 7 or greater earthquakes globally in 2024 against a long-run average near 15, and 99 earthquakes above magnitude 6, the fewest since 1982. 2025 recorded 15 in the magnitude 7 range, at the long-run average. The 2025 Atlantic hurricane season produced no continental US hurricane landfall, the first such year in a decade.
evidence.rationale: This is one of the few acceleration claims with a published series behind it, and the series goes the wrong way. The year immediately following the Rosh Hashanah he named was the quietest for magnitude 6 earthquakes in over four decades, and the following hurricane season was the first in ten years with no US landfall. Wars did escalate, but weather and earthquakes were named specifically and both fell. Scored contradicted rather than partial because the measurable half is not merely absent, it is below normal.

evidence.summary: Hundreds of generals and admirals were summoned to Quantico on 30 September 2025, where Hegseth and Trump gave speeches on warrior ethos, fitness and grooming standards, followed by ten directives. Analysts noted what did not happen: no purge of officers, no change to the oath, and no demand for partisan loyalty. The summons had been reported publicly on 25 September, the day before he spoke.
evidence.rationale: The meeting was already in the news when he described it, so the only forward content was that something much bigger than met the eye lay behind it. Nothing bigger emerged: the substance was standards and messaging, and the specific alternative he floated, that they were all simply being fired, did not happen either. A claim that an announced event conceals a hidden meaning fails when the event turns out to mean what it appeared to mean.

evidence.summary: No hurricane struck or threatened Miami in late September 2025. Hurricane Humberto reached category 5 over open Atlantic water on 27 September and Hurricane Imelda tracked up Florida's east coast offshore around 30 September before being steered out to sea, producing surf and rip currents but no landfall. The 2025 season ended with no continental US hurricane landfall at all, the first time in a decade. Hurricane Melissa struck Jamaica on 28 October.
evidence.rationale: A named city, a named scale and a named window, and the season went the other way so completely that the entire country was spared. Imelda's offshore track past Florida's east coast is the closest thing to a match and it produced surf, not Katrina. The July 2026 retelling then re-points the same word at Florida's Atlantic coast without a date, which is the rolling forward the database exists to record.

evidence.summary: The year to October 2025 brought serious events but nothing describable as upheaval beyond comprehension: a 19 percent equity drawdown that fully recovered, a twelve-day Israel-Iran war, and one political assassination in the United States.
evidence.rationale: Birth pangs intensifying beyond anybody's comprehension has no measure, and the extractor marked two of the three tellings unfalsifiable when they were written. The structure is self-sealing: a quiet period is early labour and a violent one is intensification. The one thing that would count against him, being raptured out beforehand, he explicitly rejects, which removes the last falsifier.

evidence.summary: 3I/ATLAS, the third known interstellar object, made its closest approach to the Sun on 30 October 2025 and passed nearest Earth in December 2025. NASA and the mainstream astronomical community classify it as a comet. The alien-ship reading is associated with an individual Harvard astronomer's speculation, not with an institutional Harvard announcement. Nothing arrived and nothing occurred on 29 or 31 October 2025.
evidence.rationale: He does not make this claim; he reports that viewers told him Harvard had said it, and later reports that a lot of people are naming two October dates. The extractor recorded both times that these are other people's dates, repeated without endorsement. Under the corpus rule that a clip he plays is not a claim he makes, there is nothing here to score against him, and the record should say why rather than leave it open. The underlying object is real and is a comet.

evidence.summary: The statement fixes his prophetic calendar as running Rosh Hashanah to Rosh Hashanah rather than January to January. Rosh Hashanah 2024 fell on 2-4 October and Rosh Hashanah 2025 on 22-24 September.
evidence.rationale: The extractor's note is exactly right and worth keeping: this is not a claim, it is a reading instruction, and it matters because it is the key to how his year claims should be scored. Nothing here could have failed. Recorded as unfalsifiable and flagged as methodologically useful.

evidence.summary: Director of National Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard declassified documents in July 2025 alleging that Obama-era officials manufactured intelligence on Russian interference, named Obama, Clapper, Brennan, Rice, Kerry, Lynch and McCabe, and sent a criminal referral to the Justice Department; Attorney General Bondi created a strike force in response. Contemporaneous fact-checking disputed her characterisation of the underlying assessments. The Epstein files dispute ran through the same months.
evidence.rationale: He named July through October on 22 April, and the largest disclosure fight about the previous administrations did run across exactly those months. Two deductions. Uncovering and exposure claims are the highest-base-rate category in American politics, where a disclosure story is always running. And the substance was contested rather than established: the declassifications were characterisations of existing documents, disputed at the time, and no charge resulted in the window.

evidence.summary: Nothing in October 2025 corresponds to supernatural windows and doors opening for people who have been believing a long time. The month was dominated in the United States by the federal government shutdown, which ran from 1 October to 12 November 2025.
evidence.rationale: The extractor called it at corpus level before the fact: private breakthroughs over an unnamed audience. One listener's good month confirms it and no aggregate refutes it. Recorded so it stops counting as unchecked.

evidence.summary: Nothing came down out of the sky into the Vatican, and no object struck St Peter's Square or the courtyard where a new pope is announced, between June and October 2025 or since. Leo XIV was elected on 8 May 2025 and the Vatican reported no such incident.
evidence.rationale: One of the most specific images in the corpus: a named place, a named part of that place, a described mechanism and a five-month window he counts out himself. Nothing happened. Specific and falsifiable claims are what make the database worth keeping, and this one failed cleanly.
